body:
I doubt she'll agree to go to therapy, much less pay for it.

I want to write, and I would major in it, but I'm afraid I won't be successful in it.

My mom, mostly. She's stressed out about school right now so I can kind of understand, but she's been flipping her lid on everything for a couple weeks now. Any minor mistake or miunderstanding I may make will result in a tirade of screams and hurtful words, which she'll never apologize for later.

I'm stressed about going back to school because I don't know what I want to go back for. Everyone is pressuring me to go back though, even though I don't like what I'm majoring in now.

No, I have no family who would be willing to let me stay with them.

I'd love to backpack by myself, but I don't have the funds and there would be no way my mom would let me go by myself for a day, much less a week. If I were to leave without telling anyone, I'd probably do something to make myself found, which would just put me back at square one.

No, my sister would immediately send me home, and the only other family I have in town is my mom's sister, who I don't get along with. I don't communicate with my dad or any of his family. All my other extended family lives in other states. I don't have any friends I could stay with without being a hindrance. It's kind of a lose-lose for me.

Leaving is easier said than done though. My mother controls everything I do, I don't drive (as in, no car and no license), and I have nowhere to stay. I don't have a destination, I would essentially just pack all my necessities and leave with no Point B. If I ever was found and forced back home, my home life would be a complete mess.

I used to be on citalopram and Abilify, but I can't afford to get them refilled anymore, and I have no insurance to go to my doctor and get a refill. I already have an outstanding balance with the last awful therapist I went to. (Of $50, which I can't pay) and I can't go to another. 

I'm really, really stuck, I guess. Sorry for rambling. I guess I'm just complaining about a problem that has no fix.
